correctness.rationale: The 4-digit expansions and digit sums are polynomial identities for all even b>=12. The gcd identities (2b-1)(2b+1)-4(b^2-2)=7 and 4(b^2-2)-(2b-3)(2b+3)=1 prove squarefreeness for the stated conditions. Prime-square local factors 1/2,7/9,40/49,1-(3+(2/p))/p^2 are derived exactly; CRT and a union bound for large prime squares establish positive exact natural density, with pi(T)=o(T). Standalone independent integer checks corroborate finite ranges but are not substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Resolves a natural even-parity subfamily of an explicit squarefree-noninjectivity question, with uniform four-digit witnesses and exact positive density approximately 0.2696 among bases. The arithmetic structure and density are not implied by the existing odd-base squarefree family, nor by nonsquarefree noninjectivity. This is a motivated infinite-family boundary, not an arbitrary finite sample.
